instruction:
Perform pre-release height maintenance on the native Altium PCB footprint library `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\connector_lib.PcbLib` instead of exporting a manifest. Save the modified native library as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\connector_lib_release.PcbLib` in Altium Designer.

Requirements:
- Change `Height` of `RESC3216X60X45ML15T20` to `25mil`.
- Change `Height` of `51163-0500-Footprint-1` to `90mil`.
- Change `Height` of `53375-0510-Footprint-1` to `100mil`.

The evaluation checks footprint metadata inside the native `.PcbLib`, not an external release manifest text.
source: Local Altium example `Harness Demo MB\Libs\PCB1.PcbLib`; benchmark task substantially redesigned from the text-only release-manifest degeneration and should receive a source refresh.
